info.name: vAccount-UserAPI
info.description: Testing environment only. Covers the SaaS and User resources — see vAccount-UserAPI.html for the full field reference, error codes, and status behavior. Authentication is handled automatically by the Postman Interceptor Chrome extension once you're logged into the product in Chrome — see the HTML guide's Postman setup section.

variable.description: Testing environment (appsettings.Testing.json → App:BaseUrl). This collection targets Testing only.

Calling product identifier — the identifier of whichever client app is calling this API (e.g. scl-website). Not stored in this project's own config; supplied by each calling client app. Prefixed with test- to run in test mode.
